request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. 92 BPM, G minor, 4/4 with a subtle 2+3+3 eighth-note forge rhythm. Pitched soft anvil and found metal on D and A, pizzicato double bass, a weary lyrical solo cello bringing B-flat in a gentle slide. Eternal rain and names lost in water; melancholy labour rather than action. Keep rain outside the music: no literal environmental rain recording. Develop a quiet A-B-A-prime shape, introduce a memorable cello phrase early, generous breathing room. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
